Checks first, in this order, the first failure is the result and nothing is written: 1. per id in ids order, Card Brief's findCard (its failure); 2. per id, an acceptance null or blank after trim → 2 RefusalError "card has no acceptance"; 3. a target path of two listed cards → 2 RefusalError "target is in cards and " (a the earlier in ids order, the first such pair). order = the deck's generations (cards' Layer Generations of the loaded deck) flattened, kept to the listed ids: a card comes after every listed card it depends on, else in deck order. 4. With fromRun: dir = RUNS_DIR + "/" + fromRun; not a directory under root → 4 UsageError "no run under .morph/runs". Per pick p in order: its card = p with a final /\.v[0-9]+$/ removed (none → no card), then a final /\.r[0-9]+$/ removed; not one of ids → 4 UsageError "--pick

names no card of --id"; a card picked before → 4 UsageError "--pick names twice". The variant of a card is its pick, else ".v1". report = JSON.parse of dir/report.json (not a regular file or not JSON → no requests). Per card in ids order: model = the string model of the first report.requests entry whose customId is the variant, none → 2 RefusalError "no request in

/report.json"; dir/answers/.answer.txt not a regular file → 2 RefusalError "no answer "; compiler's parseAnswer(its UTF-8 text, the card's targets) {corrupt: m} → 2 RefusalError "answer is corrupt: ", {truncated} → 2 RefusalError "answer is truncated". Without fromRun: variant null, model args.model for every card. 5. With commit only: outside = Accept Card's changedOutside(root, the listed targets, env), taken before any write; else null. 6. With fromRun: snapshot = acceptance's snapshotTargets(root, the listed targets in order); every parsed file written under root (parent directories made, UTF-8), cards in order. Without fromRun nothing is written: the tree is the payer's. 7. Per card in order, runAcceptance(acceptance, root, {env: deps.env, timeoutMs: deps.timeoutMs or DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS}) on that one tree; every card runs, a red one stops nothing; green = exit 0. 8. Every card green, outside null or empty, and commit: per card in order git's commitPaths(root, targets, "morph : ", trailers, env, force true), trailers with fromRun [Morph-Card , Morph-Model , Morph-Variant , Morph-Run , Morph-Acceptance-Exit 0], without [Morph-Card , Morph-Model , Morph-Acceptance-Exit 0, Morph-Debt true]; a null commit → that card's reason "nothing to commit: the targets equal HEAD". 9. With fromRun and no commit made → restoreSnapshot(snapshot): every target back to its bytes (or absence) before step 6; restored true. Else restored false (a payer's tree is never touched). Each card entry {card, variant, model, exit, timedOut, green, log, commit: sha or null, diffstat or null, reason: "acceptance failed (exit )" when red, the nothing-to-commit text, or null}, keys in that order. document {deck, run: fromRun or null, cards (in order), outside, green: every card green, committed: the number of commits made, restored, reason}, keys in that order; reason = the parts "red: " and "changed outside the targets: " that apply, "; "-joined, or null. code 0 when every card is green, outside is null or empty and (not commit, or committed equals the number of cards), else 1. Schema: { deck, run: string | null, cards: { card, variant: string | null, model, exit: number | null, timedOut: boolean, green: boolean, log: string, commit: string | null, diffstat: { files, insertions, deletions } | null, reason: string | null }[], outside: string[] | null, green: boolean, committed: number, restored: boolean, reason: string | null } ## Component requirements / guardrails Requirements: - Strict TypeScript: tsconfig strict, ESM, no `any`; every module compiles with tsc --noEmit. - One Document Out: Every command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout and nothing else; the human log goes to stderr. - Deterministic Core: cards and compiler give byte-identical results for the same inputs: no clock, no randomness, no environment reads. acceptance is bound only in its pure parts (Snapshot Targets, Build Attempt Diff): Run Acceptance spawns a shell and its only timer is the child's timeout; env and the timeout are parameters, never process.env (06.10, P3). processor reads the environment only in Read Registry; Assemble Request, Read Response, Stub Answer, Assemble Batch and Read Batch are pure of clock and network; the transport and its sleep are parameters of Send Generation and Send Batch (P4, P11). git spawns only in Run Git, synchronously, with the child's environment given whole as a parameter; it reads no process.env and no clock of its own (P6). cli touches the process only in its entry src/cli.ts: the environment, the working directory, the clock and the output streams reach main() as parameters, and the environment reaches the processor only through Read Registry (P7). language is pure data and pure functions: no clock, no environment, no file system, no child process; node:path is its only Node module; its shell lines are text (P8). contour reads no file, no clock and no environment: it parses the text it is given; the package yaml is imported in Parse Document alone (P9). planner reads no file, no clock and no environment: the cli reads the record and the map and passes which files exist as a function; node:path is its only Node module (P10a). builder reads no file, no clock and no environment: the caller passes the checks, the cards, the profile and the texts of the guard, the locator and the probes; node:path is its only Node module (P10b). primer reads files and spawns git (git's gitOk, the environment a parameter) only in Primer Command, the clock only there through deps.now; Read Runs, Read Story and Render Primer are pure functions of what they are given, no network anywhere (P12a). scout reads no clock, no environment and no network and spawns nothing: Parse Turn, Spend Budget and Seed From Ownership are pure; Cage Path and Run Tool reach the file system only through the ScoutFs parameter (realpath, readFile); elapsed time is a parameter; node:path is its only Node module (P13a). scout-session reaches the model only through the processor's Send Generation and the clock only through deps.now; Run Scout reads the tree through the ScoutFs parameter; Scout Command and Plan From Scout are the scout layer's two node:fs files (git through gitOk and runGit, node:crypto for the sha256 in Scout Command), the environment a parameter (P13b). reviewer's checks (Find Obligations, Check Envelope, Check Guardrails, Plan Mutants, Render Findings) are pure functions of the record, git's outputs and the texts they are given: no file, no clock, no environment, no child process, no Node module (P14a). review-session spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance (the mutant runs, each under its timeout) and git's Run Git; Run Mutants writes only through acceptance's Restore Snapshot; Review Command is the reviewer layer's one node:fs file (the record, the map and scout.json read, the review written), the environment a parameter, no clock and no model call (P14b). debt spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance and git's Run Git, reads the deck file, the card's files and the run archive through node:fs, no clock and no model call; the environment is a parameter (P17). scaffold reads the template folders and writes the new project through node:fs (node:url only to find the package root from its own module file), spawns nothing, reads no clock and no environment (P18). - Node Only: Runtime dependencies: Node 20 built-ins and the package `yaml` (the record reader), nothing else; dev dependencies pinned exactly, no ^ or ~. Guardrails: - No Network In Tests: tests/setup.ts makes fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and net.connect throw "network blocked in tests"; only the processor's own transport is mocked. - No Shell Outside Acceptance: child processes are spawned only by Run Acceptance, the git module (in Run Git alone, P6) and the processor's none; everything else is pure. - Frozen Tree During Run: while a run is in flight no file outside the cards' targets and .morph/ changes; a changed declared input discards the answer unread. ## Function Parse Command

argv into one Command or a usage error.

Behaviour: parseCommand(argv) scans argv left to right. A token starting with "--" is a flag: --pretty, --judge, --write, --md and --commit take no value; --root, --deck, --processor, --run-id, --deadline, --max-cards, --max-retry-batches, --slice-cap-bytes, --spec, --component, --map, --out, --checks, --batch, --issue, --seed-file, --from-scout, --scout, --mutants, --mutant-timeout, --test, --id, --model, --from-run, --pick, --name, --language, --module, --templates, --only, --stubs, --refs take the next token whatever it is; any other flag (--x=y too) → "unknown flag: <t>"; a value flag last → "flag <t> needs a value"; a flag twice → "flag <t> given twice", but --component repeats, its values in argv order (the first error by argv wins). Other tokens are words, giving the command: none → "no command (commands: deck check, plan, run, submit, collect, primer, scout, review, card, accept, init)"; "run"; "plan" ("plan --from-scout" when --from-scout is given); "submit"; "collect"; "primer"; "scout"; "review" with two words after it (<base> <head>); "card"; "accept"; "init"; "gate"; "deck" "check"; a first word report → NotYetError "command report is not available yet"; "deck" add|status|reset|clear → NotYetError "command deck <w> is not available yet"; else "unknown command: <words, space-joined>". An extra word → "unexpected argument: <first extra>". Then in order: a flag the command does not take → "flag <f> does not apply to <command>", in argv order (every command takes --root and --pretty, and: deck check --deck, --slice-cap-bytes; run --deck, --processor, --run-id, --deadline, --max-cards, --max-retry-batches; plan --spec, --component, --map, --judge, --out, --checks, --only; review --spec, --map, --scout, --mutants, --mutant-timeout, --test, --write; submit --deck, --processor; collect --batch; primer --write; gate --deck, --stubs, --refs, --mutants); card and accept: no --deck → "missing --deck", no --id → "missing --id", an --id not matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ → "--id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ (got '<v>')" (accept: an --id holding "," must be distinct ids joined by ",", each matching it, else "--id must be distinct card ids joined by \",\" (got '<v>')"), card done; ## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Strict TypeScript: tsconfig strict, ESM, no `any`; every module compiles with tsc --noEmit.
- One Document Out: Every command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout and nothing else; the human log goes to stderr.
- Deterministic Core: cards and compiler give byte-identical results for the same inputs: no clock, no randomness, no environment reads. acceptance is bound only in its pure parts (Snapshot Targets, Build Attempt Diff): Run Acceptance spawns a shell and its only timer is the child's timeout; env and the timeout are parameters, never process.env (06.10, P3). processor reads the environment only in Read Registry; Assemble Request, Read Response, Stub Answer, Assemble Batch and Read Batch are pure of clock and network; the transport and its sleep are parameters of Send Generation and Send Batch (P4, P11). git spawns only in Run Git, synchronously, with the child's environment given whole as a parameter; it reads no process.env and no clock of its own (P6). cli touches the process only in its entry src/cli.ts: the environment, the working directory, the clock and the output streams reach main() as parameters, and the environment reaches the processor only through Read Registry (P7). language is pure data and pure functions: no clock, no environment, no file system, no child process; node:path is its only Node module; its shell lines are text (P8). contour reads no file, no clock and no environment: it parses the text it is given; the package yaml is imported in Parse Document alone (P9). planner reads no file, no clock and no environment: the cli reads the record and the map and passes which files exist as a function; node:path is its only Node module (P10a). builder reads no file, no clock and no environment: the caller passes the checks, the cards, the profile and the texts of the guard, the locator and the probes; node:path is its only Node module (P10b). primer reads files and spawns git (git's gitOk, the environment a parameter) only in Primer Command, the clock only there through deps.now; Read Runs, Read Story and Render Primer are pure functions of what they are given, no network anywhere (P12a). scout reads no clock, no environment and no network and spawns nothing: Parse Turn, Spend Budget and Seed From Ownership are pure; Cage Path and Run Tool reach the file system only through the ScoutFs parameter (realpath, readFile); elapsed time is a parameter; node:path is its only Node module (P13a). scout-session reaches the model only through the processor's Send Generation and the clock only through deps.now; Run Scout reads the tree through the ScoutFs parameter; Scout Command and Plan From Scout are the scout layer's two node:fs files (git through gitOk and runGit, node:crypto for the sha256 in Scout Command), the environment a parameter (P13b). reviewer's checks (Find Obligations, Check Envelope, Check Guardrails, Plan Mutants, Render Findings) are pure functions of the record, git's outputs and the texts they are given: no file, no clock, no environment, no child process, no Node module (P14a). review-session spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance (the mutant runs, each under its timeout) and git's Run Git; Run Mutants writes only through acceptance's Restore Snapshot; Review Command is the reviewer layer's one node:fs file (the record, the map and scout.json read, the review written), the environment a parameter, no clock and no model call (P14b). debt spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance and git's Run Git, reads the deck file, the card's files and the run archive through node:fs, no clock and no model call; the environment is a parameter (P17). scaffold reads the template folders and writes the new project through node:fs (node:url only to find the package root from its own module file), spawns nothing, reads no clock and no environment (P18).
- Node Only: Runtime dependencies: Node 20 built-ins and the package `yaml` (the record reader), nothing else; dev dependencies pinned exactly, no ^ or ~.

Guardrails:
- No Network In Tests: tests/setup.ts makes fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and net.connect throw "network blocked in tests"; only the processor's own transport is mocked.
- No Shell Outside Acceptance: child processes are spawned only by Run Acceptance, the git module (in Run Git alone, P6) and the processor's none; everything else is pure.
- Frozen Tree During Run: while a run is in flight no file outside the cards' targets and .morph/ changes; a changed declared input discards the answer unread.
